title: PhantomBeam
description: Let End crystals kill phantoms on your server!
body:
PhantomBeam allows end crystals to kill phantoms within a radius of 48 blocks (configurable)

# **Features**
Kill phantoms using end crystals
Full customization of sounds, particles, and other parameters
Does not kill phantoms that are behind the wall
# **Note**
This is my first plugin. It was developed exclusively for my server on version 1.21.10, and I decided to share it here. I have not tested it on other versions or cores, but in theory it should work on the versions mentioned above, on Spigot, Paper, and its forks (PufferFish, Plazma, PurPur...)
If the plugin is in demand, I will release updates and add support for other versions and cores. Java 21 is required
# **Video**
https://youtu.be/6vcY08fE8K8
# **Installation**
Download the plugin
Move the plugin file to the plugins folder on your server
Restart the server
# **Commands and permissions:**
/phantombeam reload - reload the configuration | phantombeam.reload
